How can you increase the strength of an electromagnet?

Motor Effect.q: Which rule is used to find the direction of force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field?
What is the function of the commutator in a DC motor?
Motor Effect.a: It reverses the current direction each half turn to keep the motor rotating continuously
d: It acts as a switch to turn the motor on and off

Generators.a: Inducing a voltage by moving a conductor relative to a magnetic field

Generators.q: What type of current does an AC generator produce?
Generators.a: Alternating current - direction reverses each half turn
d: Direct current - always flows one way

Transformers.q: What is the turns ratio formula for a transformer?
Transformers.a: Primary voltage divided by secondary voltage equals primary turns divided by secondary turns
d: Primary voltage times secondary turns equals secondary voltage times primary turns
Primary turns plus secondary turns equals total voltage

Transformers.q: Why do transformers only work with AC?
Transformers.a: AC produces a constantly changing magnetic field needed to induce a voltage
d: DC is too dangerous for transformers
AC has higher voltage than DC
Transformers only work with copper wire

Transformers.q: Why is electricity transmitted at high voltage?
Transformers.a: High voltage means lower current which reduces power loss in cables (P = I squared R)
d: High voltage is safer for consumers
